spec.prereg: CONSILIENCE (per-episode agreement + shuffle-null across triangulation paths)
spec.scores: per episode PRE-MID: weg1_texture=LOGO RF pre-prob delta; weg2_ar1/weg2_var=envelope AR1/logVar delta; weg3_centroid/specent/hf=spectral-shape delta
spec.metric: Spearman rho of per-episode scores over common valid episodes; permutation null shuffles one vector's episode order (n_perm=10000), two-sided p = share |rho_perm|>=|rho_obs|
spec.weg3_caveat: weg3 shares representation with weg1 -> weg1<->weg3 reported, NOT counted as independent corroboration
spec.pass_rule: PASS(pair)=perm p<0.05; CONSILIENCE = >=1 independent (weg1<->weg2) pair PASS with same sign on UWE and RIMD; else honest divergence readout
